text:
alex: Quick PR opened to add a C# sample for Optimize prefetch + a short migration blurb on quant profiles. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123
priya: Sweet. Can you paste the C# snippet here so I can sanity check the API names?
alex: Excerpt in PR. Uses `using (var client = new PrefetchClient()) { await client.PrefetchAsync(...); }`. Batch example shows batchSize=5, seq=1024.
Tom: Note: SDK rename from `Prefetcher` -> `PrefetchClient` happened last year; double-check constructor args.
alex: Yup, used `PrefetchClient(options)` and added a migration note: "Prefetcher -> PrefetchClient, setup() -> init()".
lilly: UX nit: avoid wording "turn on prefetch". Use "configure per-route prefetch rules" and point to Console.
alex: Updated copy to "configure per-route prefetch rules (Console -> Optimize -> Prefetch)" and added anchor /console/optimize/prefetch#per-route.
docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [ ] reviewer assigned, [ ] snippets linted, [ ] links validated, [ ] perf note added
priya: Can you add the test conditions for the perf note? People reproduce inconsistently otherwise.
alex: Added small perf note: "local A100 trial: ~10ms/token (batch 5, seq 1024, qprof-net-int8)" and a bullet of conditions: - hw: A100 - batchSize: 5 - seqLen: 1024 - quant profile: qprof-net-int8
Tom: Also add a fallback reminder: if prefix missing runtime falls back to pinned model variant (v1-medium). Many customers assume prefetch creates prefixes.
alex: Added fallback note with crosslink to /docs/optimize/fallbacks.
ci-bot: checks: md-lint passed, snippets/csharp-format failed (style)
alex: Fixing style with dotnet format, pushing small commit.
(90s later)
ci-bot: snippets/csharp-format passed, link-bot: 1 external redirect detected (partner page)
alex: Updated partner URL to canonical.
docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [x] reviewer assigned (priya), [x] snippets linted, [x] links validated, [x] perf note added
priya: Quick code nit: show `using var client = new PrefetchClient(opts);` rather than `using(...)` for modern C# style. Also show `try { await client.PrefetchAsync(...).ConfigureAwait(false); } catch (Exception ex) { /* handle */ }`.
alex: Done. Pushed change.
priya: LGTM. If Tom's happy with wording we can merge before Friday's docs window.
Tom: wording good. One micro: change "minimal observed quality delta" language for quant profiles and link to evals.
alex: Swapped text to "minimal observed quality delta" and added /docs/optimize/evals/regression-alerts link.
docs-bot: all checks passed, preview deployed: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize/csharp-prefetch-migration
priya: Preview looks good, snippet highlights and links render.
lilly: Verified console anchor resolves. lgtm.
alex: Merged & deployed to production. Thanks team! :tada:
